slug: 2025-10-23 Congo relaunches NIU biometric unique-ID card production

facts.fact: The Finance Ministry says the NIU is issued to every foreign resident and Congolese citizen from age 6, valid 10 years, free for individuals.
The NIU modernised in 2020 (order 5327) captures iris and fingerprints in physical presence, and Minister Christian Yoka frames it as curbing duplicates and fraud.
Les Depeches de Brazzaville reports that 25,549 NIU (unique identification number) cards issued from 2020 to 2024 were uncollected in Pointe-Noire.
